opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Package for Small Businesses
opportunity.target_customer: Small business owners and independent content creators looking to enhance their online presence
opportunity.customer_problem: Many small businesses lack the expertise and time to create engaging short-form video content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, hampering their ability to attract and engage audiences.
opportunity.proposed_solution: A comprehensive package that includes tailored short-form video scripts, captions, and a social media strategy designed to boost engagement and reach on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
deliverables: 5 custom short-form video scripts tailored to the business's niche
5 engaging captions optimized for each platform
A 2-week content calendar for posting schedules
Basic video editing tips for DIY video production
Strategy session for social media growth
opportunity.next_action: Create a detailed outline of the service and prepare a promotional strategy to reach potential customers.
